   **Pricing and paywall.**
      5 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Sep 26, 2026 - Oct 1, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Tania Clark_, Oct 1, 2026, 1/5: "Another one of these apps you trust and then realise the so called trial for $10 is nto what gets charged the following month. I cancelled this plan over a month ago and even deleted the app and if you view my account you will notice I never used it. Now I have had huge amounts taken off my account and now for two packages namely for $55.882 and $29.99 and I most definitely would not approve this kind of money transaction. This is fraud and I will report it as such"
            2. _Yolanda Vinnicombe_, Oct 1, 2026, 1/5: "I never agreed to a subscription, and now I've been charged for a full year and monthly subscription on the same day. I need this cancelled and uninstalled immediately. This feels like a scam, being caught for something not agreed to."
            3. _Catherine Swidinski_, Sep 28, 2026, 1/5: "This app is untrustworthy!! Don't believe their sales pitch! I cancelled my subscription and was still charged on my credit card!! When I asked for a refund, they told me I wasn't getting one and tried to persuade me to buy more products from them instead. I cannot speak to a person, it is all AI!!"
